name: Một điều đang lớn
notes: chapters = seconds in film.mp4 where the film waits for a tap, taken from scene.html by stops.py: the title frame, one stop on each of the six leaves (PAUSE.inBeat into its beat, when its tag has dropped and stopped swinging), the climax (PAUSE.climax: the bud, waiting to be tapped), and the last frame (the whole plant in flower). Each sits a quarter of a frame into its frame, so a seek shows that frame and round(t * fps) finds its boxes. The film is 480 frames (20 s), the scene's own pace, so the tags drop and swing as smoothly as in the scene. hints = the scene's own words at those stops (WORDS.cue, ui.next, WORDS.hint, ui.skip); a card can override them with "chapters". reveal = null: no 3D envelope; after the last stop a tap opens the letter. slots.json: love0 ... love5 are the hand-lettered lines on the six kraft tags (text, in Mynerve), one box per frame; alpha (the 5th number) follows the tag as it drops in, fades near the foot of the screen and loses its words in the pull-back. The tags' "Lá 01" ... "Lá 06" labels are the scene's own and are in the film. A tag swings a few degrees as it drops; its words are painted level, at their own size, centred on the line. Compromises: the plant always has six leaves and grows to 46 cm (heightCm), because the film and the ruler in the margin are drawn from them; the botanical plate up the left margin ("Pl. I · Cúc họa mi · trồng cho {her}") carries her name on its side, which the player cannot paint, so it is not in the film; the riso grain the scene lays over the whole picture is left out of the film (noise over a moving camera made it about 20 MB; the tags keep their grain, and the printed card has it); the kicker, title, subtitle, cue, counter, hint and letter are the player's own. fonts = the face the player paints these slots in (latin, latin-ext and vietnamese).
